# Orchy AI

> Orchy is a hosted AI workspace. A team of AI agents (Operations, Marketing, Finance, IT, Sales and custom agents) does work in your apps, like Gmail, Google Calendar, Slack, Notion, GitHub and Stripe, and asks before anything is sent, posted, paid, deleted or shared.

- Built for virtual assistants, agencies and small teams. Each client gets a separate workspace with its own apps, agents and files.
- Hosted for you at OVHcloud, one isolated container per customer. Nothing to install.
- 1,100+ apps through One, which is part of Orchy.
- AI runs on Orchy's own account and is paid from the AI credits in your plan. There is no separate AI key to bring.
- Plans: Starter $9/month (1 seat, 100 AI credits, monthly only); Solo $19/month or $190/year (1 seat, 300 credits); Pro $39/month or $390/year (2 seats, 800 credits); Business $99/month or $990/year (5 seats, 2,000 credits). Pro and Business are coming soon: today you can buy Starter or Solo. Yearly = 2 months free. Warning at 80% of credits, pause at 100%, no rollover. 14-day refund from first payment if no AI credits have been used.
- No SOC 2 or ISO 27001 certification today.
- Orchy is a product of One Systems, Inc. Sign in: https://app.imorchy.dev/

## Product
- [AI employees](https://imorchy.dev/ai-employees): the agent team and what each role does
- [AI agent builder](https://imorchy.dev/agents): build an agent by describing the job in plain words
- [Approvals](https://imorchy.dev/approvals): human in the loop by default; what agents ask about first
- [Apps](https://imorchy.dev/apps): 1,100+ integrations through One
- [Client workspaces](https://imorchy.dev/client-workspaces): one workspace per client
- [Security](https://imorchy.dev/security): hosting, isolation, deletion
- [Pricing](https://imorchy.dev/pricing): plans and AI credits
